summary.name: MagicQuit
summary.one_liner: MagicQuit is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that automatically closes Mac apps you are no longer using.
keywords: close apps when not in use
use_cases: Closing forgotten apps to free memory
Extending battery life on a Mac laptop
Stopping background apps from using power
Excluding apps you want kept open via the menu bar
summary.what_it_does: MagicQuit automatically closes macOS apps when they are no longer being used. It does not force-quit apps; if an app has unsaved data, it asks the user to save first. Users can uncheck an app in the menu bar to stop MagicQuit from ever closing it again. System processes such as Finder and Spotlight are never closed. The page states it is lightweight, uses 0% CPU, runs fully offline, and sends no data to any server.
notable: Open source, so the code can be inspected
Asks to save unsaved work instead of force-quitting
Fully offline with no data sent to servers
Menu bar exclusion list via unchecking an app
